summary_md:
**Sympathy ([@SympathyLabs](https://x.com/SympathyLabs/status/2115052575020249187))**, quoting [@0xBakeer](https://x.com/0xBakeer/status/2115040161037992294), breaks down how **TandemLLM 0.15.0** scales on one DGX Spark: eight request "lanes" share a 128-row packed speculative draft and a CUDA-graphed joint verification pass.

Per the post and the linked CHANGELOG, that takes a *qwen3.8-27b thinkingcap* EXL3 4.0-bpw quant from ~38.3 tok/s with one lane to ~154.5 tok/s aggregate across eight.
relevance: Batched speculative decoding that roughly quadruples throughput for a 27B thinking model on a single Spark — directly relevant to running parallel agents locally.
